about.text: Cheese from Lika made from raw cows' milk. The cheese is named after the Croatian word for squeaky, because škripavac makes a distinctive sound when bitten into it.

sources.text: squeaky fresh cheese from Lika, lightly pressed and eaten within days; national protection of Lički škripavac possible, not verified
